title: Prepare and visualize data with Microsoft Power BI
Design effective reports in Power BI
notes: Teaches data visualization specifically using Power BI.

title: Introduction to Cloud Infrastructure: Describe cloud concepts
Introduction to Git
notes: Foundational coverage of software configuration through version control, tracking changes, and branching. Does not cover all configuration management practices.

title: An introduction to software development
notes: Foundational coverage of software modelling, object-oriented concepts and development processes. Not a comprehensive software architecture course.

title: Get started with unit testing
notes: Practical unit-testing tutorial using Visual Studio and primarily C# examples. Covers a subset of software testing; duration not published.

title: AI Fluency
notes: Covers foundational AI, generative AI, responsible usage and critical evaluation.

title: Extending and developing your thinking skills
notes: General analytical and structured thinking course, applicable across occupations.

title: Making creativity and innovation happen
notes: General creativity and innovation course. Not specific to software engineering.

title: Develop Code Features Using GitHub Copilot Tools
notes: Practical AI-assisted coding using GitHub Copilot. Teaches generating, reviewing, modifying and rejecting AI code suggestions. Exercises require Copilot access; the Free plan is sufficient according to the provider.

title: Develop Unit Tests Using GitHub Copilot Tools
notes: Generate, run and improve unit tests using AI assistance. Exercises focus on C# in VS Code. GitHub Copilot Free is sufficient for the exercises.

title: Responsible AI with GitHub Copilot
notes: 15-minute module on responsible AI use, limitations, ethical risks and accountability when using AI-generated code.

title: Introduction to bookkeeping and accounting
notes: Introductory double-entry bookkeeping, trial balances and financial statements. General accounting education; not specific to Malaysian reporting rules.

title: Financial statement analysis and interpretation
notes: Financial ratio analysis and interpreting statements; does not fully teach preparation of financial reports.

title: Assertions and audit evidence
notes: Free audit study notes on assertions, accuracy, completeness and evidence. Partial coverage of attention to detail; no provider-published duration.

title: Professional Ethics
notes: Free accountancy and audit ethics study notes, including integrity, objectivity and independence. No provider-published duration.

title: Capital Investment Appraisal
notes: Free investment-appraisal notes on cash flows, net present value, internal rate of return and payback. Relevant to financial cost-benefit reasoning, but not a complete general cost-benefit analysis course; no provider-published duration.

title: Work smarter with Copilot prompts for finance professionals
notes: 28-minute beginner module on AI-supported finance analysis, models and reports. AI adaptation rather than financial analysis fundamentals; using Microsoft 365 Copilot features may require a paid licence.

title: Get started with finance agents
notes: 83-minute intermediate module on finance AI agents, invoice workflows, anomaly detection and reconciliation. Partial link to financial reporting, not a general attention-to-detail course. Prior accounts-receivable knowledge is expected; hands-on software may require licences.

title: Python
notes: Free beginner Python course. Provider estimates 5 hours; it teaches programming basics, not an entire data science curriculum.

title: Intro to SQL
notes: Free introductory SQL course using Google BigQuery; provider estimates 3 hours.

title: Get started with data analytics
notes: 36-minute beginner introduction to grouping, aggregating and visualizing data. Introductory coverage only, not a complete job-ready Data Analysis qualification.

title: Data Cleaning
notes: Free four-hour data cleaning course covering missing values, inconsistent entries and data formats. Pandas knowledge recommended first.

title: Pandas
notes: Free four-hour practice with loading, grouping and manipulating data. Supports data analysis and helps prepare learners for the Data Cleaning course; Python knowledge assumed.

title: Digital Marketing Certification Course
notes: Covers digital marketing strategy and campaign planning; broader marketing strategy only partially. Duration derived from provider-listed course time; may change.

title: Social Media Marketing Certification Course
notes: Social media strategy, content, distribution and performance. Duration derived from provider-listed course time; may change.

title: Market Research Essentials
notes: Covers market research methods, consumer behaviour, questionnaires, sampling, data quality and research reporting. Provider estimates 1.5–3 hours, so no exact duration is assigned. Course learning is free; optional certificates may require payment.

title: HubSpot Reporting Certification
notes: Marketing reporting and performance measurement; software-specific course. Some practical exercises may need an account or tools. Duration derived from provider-listed course time; may change.

title: Inbound Marketing Certification Course
notes: Customer-focused marketing messaging, content and lead nurturing; not a full public-speaking course. Duration derived from provider-listed course time; may change.

title: An introduction to electronics
notes: Covers elementary circuits and basic design, not professional power system engineering.

title: Introduction to Electrical Engineering Based Lab Activity Material
notes: Free educational laboratory materials. Partial foundation for electrical design; some hands-on activities require hardware.

title: LTspice Tutorial for Beginners
notes: Free introductory videos for circuit simulation. No verified total course duration.

title: Assessing risk in engineering, work and life
notes: Engineering risk principles, not a substitute for Malaysia-specific electrical safety certification.

title: Troubleshooting Electrical Control Systems
notes: Free intermediate course covering electrical fault identification, visual inspection, continuity testing, voltage measurements and troubleshooting of power and control circuits. Provider estimates 1.5-3 hours; exact duration is not specified. This supports fault diagnosis but does not fully cover industrial electrical maintenance or replace supervised practical training. Optional certificates may require payment.

title: Nursing Studies - The Physical Examination
notes: Free introductory nursing course covering patient observation, physical examination, health history and vital signs. Provider estimates 1.5-3 hours. Does not replace supervised clinical practice or Malaysian nursing registration. Optional certificates may require payment.

title: Introducing practical healthcare
notes: Healthcare support-worker course, not professional nurse training. Infection prevention covered in Your healthcare practice section. Total duration 15 hours.

title: Foundations of Nursing
notes: Free foundational nursing course covering nursing processes, care planning, patient conditions, medication safety and infection control. Provider estimates 4-5 hours. Relevant introductory knowledge, not comprehensive clinical assessment training. Optional certificates may require payment; professional practice requires appropriate qualifications and supervised training.

title: Your healthcare practice
notes: Three-hour course section introducing PPE, hygiene and infection prevention to healthcare assistants; not specialist nursing certification.

title: Medication Safety: Handling and Administration
notes: Free course covering medication administration processes, medication handling and storage, administration routes, adverse drug reactions and common medication errors. Provider estimates 1.5-3 hours, so no exact duration is assigned. Relevant to medication safety knowledge but does not qualify learners to administer medication independently. Follow Malaysian clinical policies and professional scope-of-practice requirements. Optional certificates may require payment.
